title: The meter writes an empty line as soon as it is ready, so that whoever started it can tell it has started; readers skip empty lines
covers: something other than a message written on a message channel, in a write that holds no JSON.stringify
the sender's own test skips empty lines; a reader does not
note: billing splits standard output on line ends and parses every line: JSON.parse('') throws inside its data handler, and its meter tests fail.
